promises.quote: OHFT currently provide psychological services for HMP Bullingdon and HMP Huntercombe as part of the integrated mental health team. The evidence based psychological interventions are delivered based on clinical need and sentence length, in line with the NHS Stepped Care Model and National Institute of Clinical Excellence guidance. These include psychotherapy, cognitive behavioural therapy [CBT], trauma focussed-CBT, and eye movement desensitisation and re-processing.
promises.summary: Introduce guidance for psychological therapy staff on recording declines of treatment to include consideration in caseload management supervision.
